verdict.rationale: The evidence shows runnable Python and JavaScript first requests in the official quickstart, an OpenAI-compatible REST API that third-party OpenAI SDKs could target, a gRPC API exposing the same services, and a published OpenAPI spec for generating clients. None of it explicitly names a first-party xAI SDK package, so building against official SDKs is only implied. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented first-party SDK (named packages, supported languages, install and versioning docs), SDK reference documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
